title: Tech Note: Creating a Range Slider in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The classic-form DIY range-slider technique (track + two draggable sliders built from pictures/objects) still functions in current 4D since it uses fundamental form objects and methods, but it remains a workaround for a control 4D never added natively; teams building modern web-facing UIs would more likely reach for an HTML/CSS/JS range-slider component in a Qodly or browser-based front-end instead.
